layout.body:
Introduction to Glassblowing
This hands-on class introduces adults (18+) to the art of glassblowing. You'll learn safety, shaping, and design techniques while crafting your own unique work of glass art.
No experience needed—just curiosity and closed-toe shoes! Other safety-related equipment will be provided by the instructor.
Register now—spaces are limited!
Visit www.alburcommunitycenter.com/glassblowing.

questions.stem: Who can register for the course?

options.A: Anyone who is at least 18 years old
options.B: Anyone who has worked with glass before
options.C: Anyone who has read a book on glass art
options.D: Anyone who is registered for classes at a university

questions.analysis: Who can register for the course? 原文依据： This hands-on class introduces adults (18+) to the art of glassblowing. 翻译： 这门实践课程向 18 岁及以上的成年人介绍玻璃吹制艺术。 选项分析： (A) Anyone who is at least 18 years old 任何 18 岁及以上的人 → 正确 (B) Anyone who has worked with glass before 任何有过玻璃操作经验的人 → 错误（原文明确说明无需经验） (C) Anyone who has read a book on glass art 任何读过玻璃艺术相关书籍的人 → 错误（原文未提及此要求） (D) Anyone who is registered for classes at a university 任何在大学注册了课程的人 → 错误（原文未提及此要求）

questions.stem: It can be inferred that students should wear closed-toed shoes because

options.A: they are preferred by the instructor
options.B: they offer protection during the process
options.C: they are unique to the Albur community
options.D: they help reduce the risk of falling

questions.analysis: It can be inferred that students should wear closed-toed shoes because 原文依据： No experience needed—just curiosity and closed-toe shoes! Other safety-related equipment will be provided by the instructor. 翻译： 无需经验 —— 只需好奇心和包趾鞋！其他与安全相关的设备将由讲师提供。 选项分析： (A) they are preferred by the instructor 讲师更喜欢这种鞋子 → 错误（鞋子要求与讲师偏好无关，与安全相关） (B) they offer protection during the process 它们能在操作过程中提供保护 → 正确（包趾鞋被列为安全相关要求，可推断其作用是提供保护） (C) they are unique to the Albur community 它们是阿尔伯社区特有的 → 错误（原文未提及包趾鞋与该社区的独特关联） (D) they help reduce the risk of falling 它们有助于降低摔倒的风险 → 错误（玻璃吹制的安全重点是防护操作中的危险，而非防止摔倒）
